initial_query: Find an office building to convert it into a university student residence with 60 beds under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program in Turin with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
submitted_query: Find an office building to convert it into a university student residence with 60 beds under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program in Turin with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: User explicitly asks for proximity to public transport. 'Near' implies the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93), rounded to 71.
A university student residence clearly needs nearby education facilities (universities/schools). Threshold is the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14), rounded to 75.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. This is an explicit surface requirement, so it is applied as a >= threshold. The 60-bed capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per bed was supplied. Energy class, CDP/PNRR funding, public transport proximity, and the city of Turin are not REFERENCE COLUMNS and are not mapped here.
The user requires energy class C or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through A4, B and C.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on office-type properties (tipologia_bene_immobile mapped to canonical property_type with the allowed value 'Uffici e assimilabili'), surface_area >= 850, energy_class A1–C, mobility >= 71 and education >= 75, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around 45.0677551, 7.6824892. Results are ordered by distance from that point. The 60-bed and CDP/PNRR funding criteria have no matching extracted requirement or schema column, so they are not applied.
